UC Berkeley / vLLM Team's listed product is vLLM, categorized under open source & self-hosted models, with high-throughput inference engine as the function this data names first.

The data also tags vLLM with open-source and no external data sharing, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it. Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to github.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about UC Berkeley / vLLM Team's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is listed as a university lab and a not-for-profit organization. The website on file for it is a GitHub URL. The text harvested from that URL describes GitHub itself, calling it an AI-powered developer platform used by developers, businesses, and open source communities, and describing AI and automation tools for building and shipping software. That text does not describe the vLLM team or its work.

The one product tracked for the team is vLLM, described as a high-throughput inference engine. It is open source and self-hosted, with no external data sharing, and its project page is at github.com/vllm-project/vllm.

No litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent facts are held for this organization.
